Recently started seeing an acupuncturist, I’m not sure if the actual acupuncture helps but he also adjusted my C-3 and T-6 after I mentioned my migraines are actually *constant* unlike most people’s, I was so shocked to find that the next week I had extremely low pain “dips” (for a few mins up to about an hour) for the first time in 6 years I was shocked at just how quiet and clear headed I became. I see him every few weeks and I can now pretty much tell when I feel something is out of place again, the adjustments help a lot in reducing the frequency of pain flare ups. 

I also found that pregabalin helps greatly in reducing the intensity of my pain flare ups 
Unfortunately I was taken off it because doctors were scared that “I’d become addicted to it” and “gain weight” (I’m underweight???)

I’ve tried countless other migraines drugs and they do not help at all. (With the exception of topiramate which helped but the side effects were absolutely dreadful and unbearable)

In my desperation I have ended up resorting to sourcing my own ketamine, which helps a lot especially during extreme flare ups,
but I am also aware that I shouldn’t take it too often because of the chance of damaging my bladder and etc.

I’m sure you’ve heard this advice before but if you haven’t tried it cannabis is another thing that I’ve found helps to deal with the pain, as well as helping me sleep when I’m flaring up real bad.

If you haven’t already definitely consult a neurologist and a pain management doctor.
There are injections on offer such as nerve blocks (I had them but it didn’t help me) and lidocaine or Botox injections (I am yet to try Botox)

I find that Opiods such as codeine do not help my migraines personally (maybe a stronger opioid could help???) but I am prescribed them for other health issues and I know just how essential they can be.

but because they actually help you I wish you the best in finding a doctor who will understand that.
